I, John Anthony Emmanuel Amarathunga, Minister of Landshereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the LandAcquisition Act, that the lands described below are neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisionsof that Act.

Two allotments of land in total extent of about 0.0708 Hectaredepicted in the Advance Tracing No. KU/KRN/2015/669 and dated22.12.2015, prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in the Villageof Madamegama (Ward No.11 within the Municipal Council Limits,Kurunegala) in Kurunegala Town West Grama Niladhari Division,No. 837, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Kurunegala inKurunegala District in North Western Province and bounded asfollows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Dangaha Kumbura - Galagawa Kumbura, Assmt.No. 172/2 – Extent: About 0.0514 HectareNorth: State land with Rock and Ela; East: Ela; South: Lot Band High land and Muddy land claimed by M. Kithsiri;West:High land and Muddy land claimed by M. Kithsiri.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Dangaha Kumbura - Galagawa Kumbura, Assmt.No. not known – Extent: About 0.0194 HectareNorth: Lot A; East: Ela; South: Municipal Council Road;West:Shrub Jungle and Muddy land claimed by T. J. P. Silva.
John A. E. Amarathunga,Minister of Lands.
Ref. No.: 4-3/9/2015/WS/164.Ministry of Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”,1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.07th September, 2016.
